expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply quotes the captured error "pageerror: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12", says "the page threw one uncaught error", and states that "`JSON.parse` throws a `SyntaxError`".

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply identifies `JSON.parse('{"total": 12');   // missing "}"` at app.html:5 as the cause, describing it as "a JSON string that is missing its closing brace".
